entities.summary: West Indies Federation, a political institution in Jamaica during Labour Movement, Marcus Garvey, and Self-Governance (1944–1962). Grew from Universal adult suffrage and first elections 1944 and Frome Sugar Estate. Led to the emergence of Path to Independence and Independence — August 6, 1962.
